description: Use this when the user wants place cards printable from a guest list, a place card template, or table name cards for a wedding, dinner or Thanksgiving. Convert the user's guest list, spreadsheet or a photo of a seating chart into guests (name, table, meal); use text only as a fallback. Makes tent-fold cards, 3.5 x 2 in folded (or 105 x 74 mm A7 on A4), 4 per page or 6 per Letter landscape page, with the name on both faces (back face rotated 180°), dashed fold lines, crop marks, an optional event line, table number and meal tag, sorted by table or name. Long names shrink then wrap to 2 lines. Also returns a table plan PDF. Up to 300 guests. Does not seat guests or design invitations.

event_title.description: Optional small line on each card, e.g. "Emma & Liam · 12 June 2027" or "Thanksgiving 2026".

meal.description: Meal choice shown as a small tag, e.g. Vegetarian.

name.description: Guest name as it should print, e.g. Maria Nguyễn. Up to 120 characters print; longer names are shortened.

table.description: Table number or name, e.g. 3 or "Head table".

guests.description: The guest list as objects. Convert a pasted list, a spreadsheet or a photo of a seating chart into these fields. Example: [{"name":"Ana Kowalska","table":1,"meal":"Fish"},{"name":"王芳","table":2}]. Up to 300 guests.

per_page.description: 4 (default, portrait) or 6 per page (landscape, US size on Letter only).

show_meal.description: Print the meal choice as a small tag. Default true when meals are given.

show_table.description: Print the table number on the card. Default true when tables are given.

size.description: Card size: "3.5x2" (default, US 3.5 x 2 in folded) or "a7" (105 x 74 mm folded, 4 per A4 sheet).

sort.description: table (default when tables are given: by table, then name), alpha (by full name), last (by last name) or given (list order).

text.description: Fallback only: a pasted guest list, one guest per line, e.g. "Ana Kowalska, 1, Fish" or CSV with a Name,Table,Meal header. Prefer guests.

name: generate_place_cards
title: Generate tent place cards
